Name: Barbie and The Diamond Castle Mirror (Melody's hand mirror for Fashion Sense)
Author: Mecarii
Description:
[b]How to install:[/b]

1. Make sure you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url] mod
2. Install this mod
3. Extract files
4. Drag and drop files to Fashion Sense folder
5. Check the handmirror.png if replaced
6. Open Stardew Valley and enjoy
7. Done

Just "drag and drop" or "copy and paste" <3
